title: route
description: Routing decision written by scripts/router.py: the content type detected from the brief and the workspace, and which pipeline stations run with which settings. One tool for every kind of video (vacation, tutorial, presentation, talking-head) — the router picks the stations, the stations stay the same. Deterministic, no model.

content_type.description: what kind of video this project is; drives which stations run and their settings

station_name.description: a pipeline stage the router can switch on or off; every one of them is a standalone tool in scripts/

enabled.description: false when this content type does not use the station at all

settings.description: station-specific knobs the router chose; empty object when nothing needs setting

reason.description: one short sentence: why the router enabled or disabled it

required_when.description: what must be true for the station to actually run even when enabled, e.g. a music file in the brief

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the routing run

brief.description: the brief as given, plus the hints the router parsed out of it

target_duration_s.description: length named in the brief, e.g. 'about 90 seconds'; null when the brief says nothing about length

order.description: timeline order named in the brief; null when the brief does not say

pacing.description: pacing named in the brief; null when the brief does not say

music_file.description: path of a music file named in the brief, when there is one; beat-aligned cuts only run then

ambient_only.description: true when the brief asks for ambient sound only (no music)

signals.description: the phrases and keywords that decided the content type and the settings, for the audit trail

content_type_source.description: flag = --content-type was given; brief = keywords in the brief; workspace = the analysed footage decided it; default = vacation fallback

stations.description: every known station, in run order, with the router's choice

llm_cost_usd.description: always 0: the router calls no model service
